import datetime
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

INPUT = "report.pdf"
COVER = "cover.pdf"

# Read report to determine page size and confirm it exists
reader = PdfReader(INPUT)
first = reader.pages[0]
w = float(first.mediabox.width)
h = float(first.mediabox.height)
print("Report pages:", len(reader.pages))
print("First page size:", w, "x", h)

# Create the cover page with the title and current date
date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
print("Cover date:", date_str)

c = canvas.Canvas(COVER, pagesize=(w, h))

# Title
c.setFillColorRGB(0.05, 0.13, 0.25)
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
title = "Annual Financial Report"
tw = c.stringWidth(title, "Helvetica-Bold", 30)
c.drawString((w - tw) / 2, h * 0.62, title)

# Decorative line under the title
line_y = h * 0.62 - 18
c.setStrokeColorRGB(0.05, 0.13, 0.25)
c.setLineWidth(1.5)
c.line(w * 0.3, line_y, w * 0.7, line_y)

# Date
c.setFillColorRGB(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
dw = c.stringWidth(date_str, "Helvetica", 16)
c.drawString((w - dw) / 2, line_y - 30, date_str)

c.save()
print("Cover created:", COVER)

# Prepend the cover page to the report and write back to report.pdf
writer = PdfWriter()
cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER)
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(INPUT, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)
print("Merged report written back to", INPUT)

# Verify
verify = PdfReader(INPUT)
print("Final page count:", len(verify.pages))
text = verify.pages[0].extract_text()
print("Cover page text:", repr(text) if text else "(no text extracted)")

import re

with open("report.pdf", "rb") as f:
    data = f.read()

print("size:", len(data))
print("header:", data[:20])

# Find all startxref markers (incremental updates would show several)
idxs = []
pos = 0
while True:
    i = data.find(b"startxref", pos)
    if i == -1:
        break
    idxs.append(i)
    pos = i + 1
print("startxref occurrences:", idxs)

xref_off = None
if idxs:
    last = idxs[-1]
    m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data[last:last + 120])
    if m:
        xref_off = int(m.group(1))
        print("last startxref offset:", xref_off)
        print("bytes at xref:", data[xref_off:xref_off + 24])

if xref_off is not None and data[xref_off:xref_off + 4] == b"xref":
    print("STRUCTURE: classic xref table")
    i = xref_off + 4
    entries = {}
    while True:
        while i < len(data) and data[i:i + 1] in (b"\n", b"\r", b" "):
            i += 1
        line = data[i:i + 40].split(b"\r\n")[0].split(b"\n")[0].split(b"\r")[0].strip()
        if line == b"trailer" or line.startswith(b"trailer"):
            break
        parts = line.split()
        if len(parts) != 2:
            print("unexpected xref line:", line)
            break
        start, count = int(parts[0]), int(parts[1])
        print("subsection:", start, "count", count)
        i = data.find(b"\n", i)
        if i == -1:
            i = data.find(b"\r", i)
        i += 1
        for k in range(count):
            ent = data[i:i + 20]
            off = int(ent[0:10])
            gen = int(ent[11:16])
            typ = chr(ent[17])
            entries[start + k] = (off, gen, typ)
            i += 20
        # skip EOL after entry block
        while i < len(data) and data[i:i + 1] in (b"\n", b"\r"):
            i += 1

    inuse = {k: v for k, v in entries.items() if v[2] == "n"}
    print("total xref entries:", len(entries), "in-use:", len(inuse))
    print("object numbers in use (first 60):", sorted(inuse.keys())[:60])
    print("max object number:", max(inuse.keys()) if inuse else None)

    ti = data.find(b"trailer", xref_off)
    if ti != -1:
        print("trailer bytes:", data[ti:ti + 400])
else:
    print("STRUCTURE: not a classic xref table at that offset; checking xref stream")
    if xref_off is not None:
        print("bytes there:", data[xref_off:xref_off + 80])

# General markers
print("has /ObjStm:", data.find(b"/ObjStm") != -1)
print("has /XRef (stream):", data.find(b"/XRef") != -1)
print("has FlateDecode:", data.find(b"FlateDecode") != -1)
print("has /Type /Pages:", data.find(b"/Type /Pages") != -1)
print("has /Type /Page:", data.find(b"/Type /Page") != -1)
print("has /Kids:", data.find(b"/Kids") != -1)
print("has /Count:", data.find(b"/Count") != -1)
print("has /Root:", data.find(b"/Root") != -1)
print("has /Linearized:", data.find(b"Linearized") != -1)

for num in range(9, 15):
    off = offsets[num]
